Isabella. Episode 1

Isabella, the overworked apprentice of an eccentric wizard, discovers an ancient wand and journal hidden deep within the mysterious forest. Hoping to make her chores easier, she unknowingly awakens Brunnhilde, a stunning woman created from an ordinary broom. As the pair explore the wand's bizarre transformational magic, playful experimentation quickly spirals into passion, jealousy, and unintended consequences. With the wizard's return fast approaching, Isabella must deal with the chaos unleashed by a relic that grants life in the most unpredictable—and seductive—ways.
